releaseNotes:
🚀 JBrowser v3.6.0 Official Release

• Camera QR Code Scanner: Scan QR codes directly with your camera to open links instantly
• Save Pages Offline / Reading List: Save full web pages to read anytime without internet connection
• Find-in-Page Match Counter: Shows exact 'X of Y' search result counts
• Inline History Search: Instantly filter browsing history with search bar
• Bookmark Folders: Organize bookmarks into customizable folders and categories
• Selection-Based Text Translation: Highlight text on any page for 1-tap translation
• Advanced Free Video Downloader with per-video & webpage media scraper
• Free Fast Privacy VPN & AES-256 Vault Encryption
• 100% Safe & Private (Zero Data Collection)
